title: How the magic e changes a word
examples: Why is the e at the end of cake silent?

explain.say: Look at the word cap. A cap is a kind of hat. Now add the letter e to the end. The word becomes cape.

draw.text: How the magic e changes a word

explain.say: Look at the first part: cap. The a makes its short sound, as in apple. Say cap.
Now look at the e at the end. This e is silent. It makes the a say its name. So cap becomes cape. Say cap, then cape.
This works with other vowels too. Kit becomes kite. The e at the end makes the i say its name. Draw an arrow from the e back to the i with your finger.
Look at the pairs on the board. Cap and cape. Kit and kite. Hop and hope. Cub and cube. Today, write tap, then add e. What word do you get?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: What changes when e is added?

faq.a: It is an e at the end of a word that makes no sound itself. It makes the vowel before it say its name, so cap becomes cape.

faq.q: What does say its name mean?
faq.a: Each vowel has a name, like in the alphabet song: a, e, i, o, u. The magic e makes the vowel sound like its name.

faq.q: Does the magic e make a sound?
faq.a: No. The e at the end is quiet. Its job is to change the vowel sound before it.

faq.q: What words have a magic e?
faq.a: Cake, bike, home, cube, tape and kite all have one.

faq.q: How do I spot a magic e when I read?
faq.a: Look at the end of the word. If you see a vowel, then one consonant, then e, try saying the vowel name. A few words, like have and give, break the rule, and a teacher or grown-up can help with those.
asks: How do I know when e is magic?

facts: Adding an e to the end of cap makes cape, and kit becomes kite.
In words like cape and kite, the e at the end is silent.

quiz.say: Add e to the end of hop. What word do you get?
quiz.why: The e at the end makes the o say its name. Hop becomes hope.

wrong.0: Hoop has two o letters and ends with p.
wrong.1: Hip has a different vowel, i, and ends with p.

quiz.say: Look at the word kite. What sound does the e make?
quiz.show: 🪁 kite: what sound does the e make?
quiz.why: The e is silent. It makes the i say its name.

wrong.0: In kite, you hear the i say its name, and the e stays quiet.
wrong.2: The ee sound comes from 2 e letters together, as in tree.
